entry.title: In Thailand, USS Abe Lincoln covered in rust after 286 days at sea

media:group.media:title: In Thailand, USS Abe Lincoln covered in rust after 286 days at sea
media:group.media:description:
As the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln pulled into port in Thailand on Wednesday, observers were shocked by its appearance. The almost 1,100-foot-long warship was covered in rust from bow to stern.
But experts say that’s to be expected from what the Navy says was 286 days at sea since the Lincoln left its homeport of San Diego last November. The warship also saw months of combat and blockade operations against Iran in the Middle East.

entry.title: 89% of Americans now say gov't corruption is widespread: CNN debates

media:group.media:title: 89% of Americans now say gov't corruption is widespread: CNN debates
media:group.media:description:
Nearly 90% of Americans say corruption is widespread in government, the highest level in 20 years and up 10% from last year. Significant majorities of Republicans, Democrats, and independents all agree that government corruption is widespread.
Despite the bipartisan outrage, politicians of both parties are playing the market, and companies linked to President Trump and his family are making money from cryptocurrency, defense and selling early access to Trump's social media posts.

entry.title: Deadly mass shooting in Minneapolis high-rise

media:group.media:title: Deadly mass shooting in Minneapolis high-rise
media:group.media:description:
Officers confronted a barrage of gunfire, their vision clouded by a haze, as they responded to a shooting at a Minneapolis apartment building Wednesday that left at least two people dead and injured multiple others, officials said.
Police exchanged gunfire with the shooter as they rushed to rescue victims and bring them to safety, Minneapolis Police Interim Chief Bill Peterson said. Three officers were injured, two of them by gunshots.
The shooter, who officials have not yet named, was also confirmed dead, officials said. Peterson said police “were familiar with who this individual was.”
